note: Rewritten from Chhotani (1997), entry 185 (p. 274); the alate, soldier and worker castes are all covered; synonymy and literature are omitted, and the distribution is not included in the entry.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule, antennae, labrum, pronotum and legs pale yellow; mandibles reddish brown. Head with moderate pilosity, body densely hairy. Body length 3.17–3.55. Head subrectangular, sides slightly convex, apical 1/3 slightly narrowed; length to mandible base 0.82–0.90, maximum width 0.61–0.71, width about 3/4 of the length. Frons in lateral view inclined at about 45°. Y-shaped suture indistinct, sometimes only the median suture near the posterior margin visible. Fontanelle situated in a shallow depression at the base of the inclined frons, minute, circular. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 the smallest. Labrum slightly asymmetrical, sides slightly convex, anterior margin broadly concave, anterolateral angles pointed. Mandibles asymmetrical, long and slender, slightly longer than the head: left mandible 0.92–0.98, right mandible 0.89–0.94. Postmentum short, subrectangular (length 0.31–0.36, maximum width 0.20–0.24, minimum width 0.17–0.22). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.11–0.18, width 0.30–0.36), width slightly less than half the head width.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head and body pale yellow, densely hairy. Body length 3.0–3.40. Head subcircular, wider than long (length to mandible base 0.57–0.67, maximum width 0.62–0.80). Postclypeus swollen, hairs conspicuous, length less than half its width. Pronotum length 0.10–0.15, maximum width 0.30–0.40.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule brown; antennae, postclypeus and pronotum slightly paler; surface of the head darker around the V-shaped suture. Head and pronotum densely hairy. Head subcircular, length to mandible base 0.55–0.57, maximum width 0.71–0.73; a shallow triangular depression behind the frontal suture; V-shaped suture distinct. Fontanelle minute, punctiform. Postclypeus swollen, slightly bilobed, length about half its width. Eyes circular, diameter 0.20–0.21, not markedly prominent. Ocelli oval (long diameter 0.08, short diameter 0.06), about half the short diameter from the eye (0.03). Antennae more than 13-segmented, segment 3 very short, segment 4 shorter than segment 2, segment 5 shorter than segment 4. Anterior margin of the pronotum slightly raised, length 0.33–0.38, width 0.51–0.56, anterior margin with a weak notch, posterior margin moderately incurved.
